_about: Content kept in data/gloss but left out of (or reworded in) the built app data by scripts/build_data.py, so the shipped text suits young children. Every rule must still match the gloss, or the build fails. See README > Hidden content.

hideSteinsaltz._about: Mishnayos whose Steinsaltz text (stIntro, st, stMore) is dropped. Their pieces then show only the simple meaning, with no Steinsaltz toggle.
hideSteinsaltz.1:7: Steinsaltz explains the fine as paid when a girl is raped or seduced.
hideSteinsaltz.4:3: Steinsaltz describes a woman's dead fetus in the womb and the midwife reaching in.
hideSteinsaltz.4:7: Steinsaltz describes the placenta as a sign of a fetus in a woman and talks about miscarrying.
hideSteinsaltz.9:2: Steinsaltz names the skin of the womb (the Mishnah's word means private parts).
